subject: DESE Comprehensive District Review Report
overview: The committee reviewed the DESE Comprehensive District Review report and new Medford High School operational policies regarding attendance, cell phones, and backpacks. The body also voted to schedule a strategic planning session to synthesize findings from recent district evaluations.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee convened in executive session to discuss strategy for negotiations with Teamsters Local 25 and to review pending litigation before the MCAD and US District Court.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved bills, payroll, and minutes from several meetings held between June and September 2023.

items.title: Superintendent Updates and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent provided updates on holiday observances, upcoming curriculum nights, the first district-wide early release day, and Mustang athletic achievements.

items.title: Medford High School Operations Update
items.summary: Principal Marta Cabral detailed new high school policies including a restorative attendance appeal process, restricted cell phone use, and the reinstatement of a classroom backpack ban.

items.title: DESE Comprehensive District Review
items.summary: District leaders presented findings from a state review that commended curriculum alignment while recommending improved data integration for English learners and students with disabilities.

items.title: Strategic Planning Committee of the Whole
items.summary: Approved a motion to schedule a Committee of the Whole to identify common themes across the DESE review and previous district reports to inform the successor strategic plan.

items.title: Resolution 2023-20: Rural Schools Bill
items.summary: Approved a resolution urging the state legislature to update funding models to support regional and rural school districts.
